fullText.simplified:
第三十九章、千年宝藏之谜

    江杨判断错了，可是一切已经晚了，他已经移动了棋子。随之而来的，是整个地面的剧烈旋转，并向南方倾斜。突然，地面出现了断裂，再往下深不见底。随着旋转的加剧，这个地方马上就要塌陷了。江杨没料到自己会判断错误，他脚下一滑，身体往下坠去。就在那一瞬间，石文谦出手，死死地拉住了他。只见石文谦几乎倒挂在地面断裂处，他原本还趴在地面上，但是随着江杨身体的坠落，石文谦也在一点点地往下滑……
    “松手吧，文谦。”江杨说道。
    石文谦的脖子和脸都红红的，他用尽了全身的力气拉着江杨，并没有要松手的意思。就在这危急关头，简西飞速拿出包里的绳子，一端系在入口处的柱子上，另一端甩到了江杨和石文谦的跟前。
    简西自己艰难地朝最后一个棋盘跑去，她知道南方朱雀，真正少的那颗星，是张星。地面向南倾斜得越来越严重，简西用两条腿缠住石柱，身体努力地向上，右手艰难地伸向棋盘。就在地面完全塌陷前，简西摆完了棋盘上的最后一颗棋子。
    就在那一瞬间，地面停止晃动，墙壁上的星星停止闪现，前方大石柱的铁盒自动打开了……

    (一个星期后)
    敦煌某个路边的茶店，石文谦和简西在晒着太阳，喝着杏皮茶。
    “文谦，盒子里的文物你们研究得怎么样了？”简西喝了一口杏皮茶问道。
    “现在还不方便说，要等最后的研究报告。”石文谦没吐露细节。
    “真小气！这也有我的功劳好么！再说我那天都看到了，羊皮国书，大概内容是主张通商，反对战争。有同样想法的西域各国都盖上了自己的印章，还有各个通商城市的地图标点，连起来就是最初的丝绸之路了吧。张骞想把这个带回去证明给汉武帝，他的方法可行，贸易也是解决问题的一种方式，和平的生活才是大家都想要的。你说我分析得有没有道理？”简西眨眨眼睛，仿佛知道了一切的样子。
    “那你再分析分析，张骞为什么后来没把这个东西取回来呢？”石文谦追问道。
    “唉！战争已经打起来了呀，张骞被匈奴人抓了，等他从匈奴逃回长安，已经是几年以后的事情了，远远超过了和汉武帝约定的期限。时过境迁，政治局面也已经发生了变化，他的努力白费了。”简西可惜地摇了摇头。
    “不能这么说，他所付出的努力功不可没。虽然那些年没能实现和平，但是通商的理念却深深留在了人们的心中。羊皮国书上的每一个印章，都是张骞为他的理想奋斗的痕迹。羊皮国书上的每一座城池，都是向往和平的证明！”石文谦感慨地说道。
fullText.traditional:
第三十九章、千年寶藏之謎

    江楊判斷錯了，可是一切已經晚了，他已經移動了棋子。隨之而來的，是整個地面的劇烈旋轉，並向南方傾斜。突然，地面出現了斷裂，再往下深不見底。隨著旋轉的加劇，這個地方馬上就要塌陷了。江楊沒料到自己會判斷錯誤，他腳下一滑，身體往下墜去。就在那一瞬間，石文謙出手，死死地拉住了他。只見石文謙幾乎倒掛在地面斷裂處，他原本還趴在地面上，但是隨著江楊身體的墜落，石文謙也在一點點地往下滑……
    “鬆手吧，文謙。”江楊說道。
    石文謙的脖子和臉都紅紅的，他用盡了全身的力氣拉著江楊，並沒有要鬆手的意思。就在這危急關頭，簡西飛速拿出包裡的繩子，一端繫在入口處的柱子上，另一端甩到了江楊和石文謙的跟前。
    簡西自己艱難地朝最後一個棋盤跑去，她知道南方朱雀，真正少的那顆星，是張星。地面向南傾斜得越來越嚴重，簡西用兩條腿纏住石柱，身體努力地向上，右手艱難地伸向棋盤。就在地面完全塌陷前，簡西擺完了棋盤上的最後一顆棋子。
    就在那一瞬間，地面停止晃動，牆壁上的星星停止閃現，前方大石柱的鐵盒自動打開了……

    (一個星期後)
    敦煌某個路邊的茶店，石文謙和簡西在曬著太陽，喝著杏皮茶。
    “文謙，盒子裡的文物你們研究得怎麼樣了？”簡西喝了一口杏皮茶問道。
    “現在還不方便說，要等最後的研究報告。”石文謙沒吐露細節。
    “真小氣！這也有我的功勞好麼！再說我那天都看到了，羊皮國書，大概內容是主張通商，反對戰爭。有同樣想法的西域各國都蓋上了自己的印章，還有各個通商城市的地圖標點，連起來就是最初的絲綢之路了吧。張騫想把這個帶回去證明給漢武帝，他的方法可行，貿易也是解決問題的一種方式，和平的生活才是大家都想要的。你說我分析得有沒有道理？”簡西眨眨眼睛，彷彿知道了一切的樣子。
    “那你再分析分析，張騫為什麼後來沒把這個東西取回來呢？”石文謙追問道。
    “唉！戰爭已經打起來了呀，張騫被匈奴人抓了，等他從匈奴逃回長安，已經是幾年以後的事情了，遠遠超過了和漢武帝約定的期限。時過境遷，政治局面也已經發生了變化，他的努力白費了。”簡西可惜地搖了搖頭。
    “不能這麼說，他所付出的努力功不可沒。雖然那些年沒能實現和平，但是通商的理念卻深深留在了人們的心中。羊皮國書上的每一個印章，都是張騫為他的理想奮鬥的痕跡。羊皮國書上的每一座城池，都是嚮往和平的證明！”石文謙感慨地說道。

sentences.pinyin: nǐ shuō wǒ fēn xī de yǒu méi yǒu dào lǐ jiǎn xī zhǎ zhǎ yǎn jing fǎng fú zhī dào le yí qiè de yàng zi
sentences.english: What do you say, does my analysis make sense?” Jian Xi blinked, as if she knew everything.

sentences.simplified: “那你再分析分析，张骞为什么后来没把这个东西取回来呢？”石文谦追问道。
sentences.traditional: “那你再分析分析，張騫為什麼後來沒把這個東西取回來呢？”石文謙追問道。
sentences.pinyin: nà nǐ zài fēn xī fēn xī zhāng qiān wèi shén me hòu lái méi bǎ zhè ge dōng xi qǔ huí lai ne shí wén qiān zhuī wèn dào
sentences.english: “Then analyze some more—why didn’t Zhang Qian take this item back in the end?” Shi Wenqian pressed.

sentences.simplified: “唉！战争已经打起来了呀，张骞被匈奴人抓了，
sentences.traditional: “唉！戰爭已經打起來了呀，張騫被匈奴人抓了，
sentences.pinyin: ài zhàn zhēng yǐ jīng dǎ qǐ lái le ya zhāng qiān bèi xiōng nú rén zhuā le
sentences.english: “Sigh! The war had already started, and Zhang Qian was captured by the Xiongnu.

sentences.simplified: 等他从匈奴逃回长安，已经是几年以后的事情了，
sentences.traditional: 等他從匈奴逃回長安，已經是幾年以後的事情了，
sentences.pinyin: děng tā cóng xiōng nú táo huí cháng ān yǐ jīng shì jǐ nián yǐ hòu de shì qing le
sentences.english: By the time he escaped from Xiongnu and returned to Chang’an, it was several years later, ..

sentences.traditional: 遠遠超過了和漢武帝約定的期限。
sentences.pinyin: yuǎn yuǎn chāo guò le hé hàn wǔ dì yuē dìng de qī xiàn
sentences.english: .. far beyond the deadline agreed upon with Emperor Wu of Han.

sentences.simplified: 时过境迁，政治局面也已经发生了变化，他的努力白费了。”
sentences.traditional: 時過境遷，政治局面也已經發生了變化，他的努力白費了。”

sentences.english: The times had changed, and the political landscape had also changed. His efforts were in vain.”

sentences.pinyin: jiǎn xī kě xī de yáo le yáo tóu
sentences.english: Jian Xi shook her head with regret.

sentences.simplified: “不能这么说，他所付出的努力功不可没。
sentences.traditional: “不能這麼說，他所付出的努力功不可沒。
sentences.pinyin: bù néng zhè me shuō tā suǒ fù chū de nǔ lì gōng bù kě mò
sentences.english: “You can’t say that. His efforts cannot be overlooked.

sentences.simplified: 虽然那些年没能实现和平，但是通商的理念却深深留在了人们的心中。
sentences.traditional: 雖然那些年沒能實現和平，但是通商的理念卻深深留在了人們的心中。

sentences.english: Although peace was not achieved in those years, the concept of trade remained deeply in people’s hearts.

sentences.traditional: 羊皮國書上的每一個印章，都是張騫為他的理想奮鬥的痕跡。

sentences.english: Every seal on the sheepskin document is evidence of Zhang Qian’s fight for his ideals.

sentence_translations: Chapter 39: The Mystery of the Thousand-Year Treasure
Jiang Yang made the wrong judgment, but it was already too late. He had already moved the chess piece.
What followed was the entire ground spinning violently and tilting towards the south.
Suddenly, a fracture appeared in the ground. Looking into it, you couldn’t see the bottom.
As the spinning intensified, this place was about to collapse.
Jiang Yang had not anticipated that he would make the wrong judgment. His feet slipped, and his body fell downward.
In that instant, Shi Wenqian extended his arm out and grabbed him firmly.
Shi Wenqian could be seen almost hanging upside down at the fracture in the ground.
He was originally still lying on the ground, but as Jiang Yang’s body fell down, Shi Wenqian was also sliding down bit by bit …
“Let go, Wenqian,” Jiang Yang said.
Shi Wenqian’s neck and face were both red. He used all his strength to pull Jiang Yang and had no intention of letting go.
At this critical moment, Jian Xi quickly took a rope out from her bag.
She tied one end to a pillar at the entrance and flung the other end to Jiang Yang and Shi Wenqian.
Jian Xi ran towards the final chessboard with great difficulty.
She knew that what was truly missing from the Vermilion Bird of the South was the Extended Net Mansion.
The ground was tilting southward more and more severely.
Jian Xi wrapped her legs around the stone pillar and strained her body upward, ..
.. reaching for the chessboard with her right hand with great difficulty.
Just before the ground completely collapsed, Jian Xi placed the last piece on the chessboard.
In that instant, the ground stopped shaking, the stars on the wall stopped flashing, ..
.. and the iron box on the large stone pillar in front of them opened automatically …
(One week later)
At a roadside tea shop in Dunhuang, Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi were basking in the sun, drinking apricot peel tea.
“Wenqian, how is your research on the cultural relic that was in the box going?” Jian Xi asked, taking a sip of apricot peel tea.
“It’s not the right time to talk. We have to wait for the final research report.” Shi Wenqian did not reveal the details.
“So stingy! I deserve some credit for this too!
Besides, I already saw it that day, the sheepskin document, the general content of which advocates for trade and opposes war.
Countries in the Western Regions with the same idea had all stamped their own seals.
There are also marked points on the map of various trading cities.  If we connected them, we would get the initial Silk Road, right?
Zhang Qian wanted to take this back to prove to Emperor Wu of Han that his method was feasible, ..
.. that trade was also a way to solve problems, and that a peaceful life was what everyone wanted.
What do you say, does my analysis make sense?” Jian Xi blinked, as if she knew everything.
“Then analyze some more—why didn’t Zhang Qian take this item back in the end?” Shi Wenqian pressed.
“Sigh! The war had already started, and Zhang Qian was captured by the Xiongnu.
By the time he escaped from Xiongnu and returned to Chang’an, it was several years later, ..
.. far beyond the deadline agreed upon with Emperor Wu of Han.
The times had changed, and the political landscape had also changed. His efforts were in vain.”
Jian Xi shook her head with regret.
“You can’t say that. His efforts cannot be overlooked.
Although peace was not achieved in those years, the concept of trade remained deeply in people’s hearts.
Every seal on the sheepskin document is evidence of Zhang Qian’s fight for his ideals.
Every city on the sheepskin document is a testament to the aspiration for peace!” Shi Wenqian said with emotion.
